artworks.title: The Poacher-A Hare in View
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile holding a greyhound by the hindquarters. The man is wearing a flat cap, a long dark jacket over a shirt, dark trousers, and sturdy footwear. An object is tucked into his coat. In the background, there is a textured landscape fading into a vast, open sky with a slightly overcast appearance.

artworks.title: A Sharpshooter's Last Sleep, Gettysburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white photograph of a war-torn landscape with a fallen figure on the ground. The scene is characterized by rough terrain of rocks and muddy, uneven earth. In the center of the image, a figure is lying flat among the grass and dirt, with a gun laying on the ground next to them. They have light skin, dark hair, and a dark jacket open to show a white shirt. There are many shapes in the background that could be other bodies or the remnants of clothing or belongings.

artworks.title: School Street, Boston
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a bustling urban street scene from the past. The image features a cobblestone street lined with tall, narrow brick buildings with multiple stories. Each building displays large signs advertising various businesses, such as a medical college, law offices, and book stores. The street is filled with movement as carriages, presumably horse-drawn, travel up and down the road alongside parked vehicles. Awnings extend over the sidewalk. The architecture reflects a historical era with its uniform windows, chimneys, and intricate facades, adding to the overall charm of the scene. The photograph captures a busy commercial district during that time.

artworks.title: Boston Common Snow Scene
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a winter scene from an elevated perspective. A snow-covered parkway is seen with barren trees lining it. Close to the viewer, there is an ornate snow-covered fence leading into the park area. A path through the snow directs the gaze towards the distance where trees fade into the horizon. Buildings on the left are partly hidden by trees, with faint architectural details visible. The monochromatic palette of sepia tones creates a serene atmosphere, highlighting the contrast between snow-laden branches and the muted background. The photo conveys a sense of stillness associated with snowfall.

artworks.title: Brattle Square Church
artworks.medium:
salted paper print
salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a brick building with arched windows and a street sign reading "BRATTLE SQ". A spherical object appears in the upper part of the view. The building has angular lines and decorative cornices. A cobblestone street and a horse-drawn carriage are partially visible. The color palette is in sepia tones with brown and beige hues. Light and shadow contrast is created by sunlight on the building's façade.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a mountain landscape from a lower perspective. There is a large rocky mountain dominating the scene, with a rugged peak visible. In the foreground, there are trees, shrubs, and a small bridge. The image has a sepia tone, with shadows and light creating depth. Different textures add complexity to the scene.

artworks.title: Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone and Falls
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon

artworks.title: Zuni Pueblo
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape with adobe structures. The perspective is slightly elevated, providing a broad view of the settlement. A solitary adobe structure is near the foreground, casting long shadows. The ground has pathways and appears to be compacted earth. The terrain rises gently towards the distant settlement, with fences and smaller structures scattered around. The sky is cloudless, blending into a neutral tone complementing the earthen colors of the adobe. The overall palette is monochromatic with variations in earthy tones.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: In this print, the white silhouettes of leaves and flowers are depicted on a deep blue background. Some of the flowers appear translucent, and the blue background can be seen through them, creating a lighter blue color. There is a thin blue border around the image, surrounded by a thicker white border.

artworks.title: Untitled (Study of the Sun's Surface)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows irregular dark spots and scattered speckles on a textured background, creating a composition of varied shapes.

artworks.title: Waymart
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph depicts a rural landscape littered with tree stumps and debris. Two people stand among the stumps, their backs to us. The person on the right wears a long light coat and a dark hat, and the person on the left wears a white shirt with a dark waistcoat and a pale gray hat and trousers. Two trees with dark leaves are visible, one on the left side and one to the right of center. In the distance is a low hill covered with white buildings. A dirt pathway winds through the landscape in the distance, and wooden fences cut through wide fields. The horizon is visible above the hills, which appear slightly obscured by light mist or fog. The sky is off-white.

artworks.title: Olyphant
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of a town nestled in a valley. The scene includes small houses and buildings set against rolling hills in the distance. The horizon is high, near the top of the image, with softly blurred outlines of hills. The sepia tone provides a warm color palette. Wooden fences, trees, and a collection of houses and buildings are visible. Smoke rises from one of the structures, suggesting industrial activity. The scene conveys a peaceful, pastoral setting with signs of bustling life.

artworks.title: Cavalry Maneuvers, Camp de Châlons
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low perspective. In the upper third of the composition, there is a horizon. Along the horizon, there is a line of soldiers in uniform standing on a mound, some on horses. The image has a monochromatic palette with warm sepia tones, giving it an antique or vintage feel. The land stretches in the foreground, leading up to the mound where the figures are silhouetted against the background. The photo has soft focus and gradual tonal transitions, enhancing the depth and serenity of the scene.

artworks.title: Carte photographique de la lune
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of the moon's surface. The image captures a close-up view of the moon along its edge, where the light from the sun casts shadows that accentuate the cratered surface. The texture and depth of the craters are prominent, with various sizes of circular depressions creating a rugged landscape. The right side of the image is shrouded in darkness, contrasting with the bright surface on the left. The photograph effectively highlights the features of the moon's topography.

artworks.title: Carte photographique de la lune
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This image features a close-up view of the lunar surface, showing a section of the Moon's topography. The perspective looks down across craters and the rough, textured landscape. The horizon is where the Moon's surface meets space. The surface has cratered formations, creating a rough, uneven terrain with detailed features illuminated by sunlight, casting shadows. The color palette is primarily gray with a slight sepia tint, emphasizing the contrast between the Moon's surface and space. This contrast highlights the surface's detailed craters and rugged features.

artworks.title: Photographie Lunaire Rayonnement de Tycho - Phase Croissante
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts the lunar surface, showing various craters of different sizes. The perspective appears to be from a high vantage point, such as a spacecraft or satellite, providing a broad view of the moon's landscape. The horizon is visible in the upper portion of the image, with a slight curvature suggesting the moon's spherical nature. Shadows and variations in surface elevations are clearly visible, resembling traditional black and white photography. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from deep black to bright white, emphasizing the texture and depth of the terrain.

artworks.title: Ferns. Specimen of Cyanotype
artworks.creditLine: R. K. Mellon Family Foundation
artworks.description: This print shows the outlines of several fern leaves in a light blue color against a dark blue background. Some of the ferns are the length of the whole page, while other shorter ones are stacked together. The words "Ferns" and "Specimen of Cyanotype" are written on the bottom edge of the print.

artworks.title: Charles Blondin walking a tightrope across Niagara Falls
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a stereoscopic image showing a person walking on a tightrope over a gorge. The scene features a tightrope extended over a natural gorge with rocky cliffs and a river below. Safety lines are visible above and around the tightrope. The background shows a natural landscape with trees and rocky formations. The image is presented in an ornate frame and the person appears to be wearing traditional attire.

artworks.title: Chien de Garvel (Martinique)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated outdoors, with most of their upper body visible and leaning against a small structure that resembles a doghouse. The individual is in a relaxed position, resting their head on their hand, which is supported by the structure. They have medium-length hair that is straight and falls naturally around their face. The person is wearing a long skirt, but their upper body is uncovered, and they are barefoot. Surrounding them are rugged and aged objects, including a wooden porch railing, some scattered items on the ground, and a dilapidated wall in the background. The environment appears to be rustic with various tools and materials lying around, enhancing the sense of an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Acoma Pueblo
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged landscape viewed from a high vantage point. A steep, rocky terrain leads to a flat plateau with ancient stone structures. The horizon is low in the frame, with open land stretching into the distance. The color palette is sepia tones, emphasizing rocky surfaces and architectural details. The sky is cloudless.

artworks.title: Nynee Tall from South End
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a negative view of a natural landscape. The perspective is from a slightly elevated viewpoint, showing treetops and mountains in the distance. The horizon is not distinct. The sky is dark, almost black. Detailed brushstrokes create texture in the foliage and mountains. The color palette is unusual due to the negative effect, with whites and grays for trees and the ground, and blacks and grays for the mountains, creating strong contrast.

artworks.title: Horses. Running. Phyrne L. No. 40
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon

artworks.title: Cathedral Spires, Valley of the Yosemite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with a river or stream reflecting the surroundings. The water is bordered by grass, bushes, and trees. A rocky face is on the right, and a mountain range is visible in the distance. The color palette is warm sepia, and the composition is balanced.

artworks.title: Studies of Foreshortenings. Horses. Walking. Mahomet. Nos. 119-120
artworks.dimensions:
image: 14 x 23.2 cm (5 1/2 x 9 1/8 in.)
sheet: 26 x 33 cm (10 1/4 x 13 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a horse in motion sequence. The image consists of a series of nine individual frames arranged in a 3x3 grid, each capturing a moment in the movement of a horse. The background is plain. Each frame shows the horse in a slightly different position. The black and white treatment appears vintage.
